source='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    full_rows = {r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1}
    full_cols = {c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1}

    return out
